executivo.nota: Leis: as 264 leis ordinárias e complementares com data a partir de 1º/1/2025 cadastradas no SAPL da Câmara, venham de quem vierem (a prefeitura sanciona quase todas). Vetos: os projetos que, pelo andamento registrado no SAPL, receberam veto total ou parcial a partir de 1º/1/2025.
executivo.nota_en: Laws: the 264 ordinary and complementary laws dated from January 1, 2025 on in the City Council's SAPL system, whoever proposed them (the mayor's office signs almost all of them). Vetoes: the bills that, according to the progress recorded in SAPL, were vetoed in whole or in part from January 1, 2025 on.
